# MIFECO Analytics Tracking Setup

## Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Configuration

### 1. Create GA4 Property
- Go to Google Analytics Admin
- Under Property, click "Create Property"
- Enter property name: "MIFECO Website"
- Select reporting time zone and currency
- Click "Create"

### 2. Install GA4 Tracking Code
- In GA4 Property, go to "Data Streams" > "Web"
- Enter website URL and stream name
- Click "Create Stream"
- Copy the Measurement ID (format: G-XXXXXXXXXX)
